source_artifact.name: FX8U Camera Processing For OP13_v3.97.zip
source_artifact.author: UltraM8
source_artifact.description: Find x8 ultra camera processing blobs port for OnePlus13.

source_handling: Derived observations only. The proprietary ZIP, libraries, models and full configs are not committed.

architecture.note: common/install.sh contains an intended dependency abort on um8s_op13_ocvm, but the line is commented out in v3.97.

target_adaptation_evidence: video_ltm.json and video_ltm_ctrl.json are keyed by project 23821.
libAlgoInterface.so exports ApsPreviewDecision23821 and capture-decision classes for rear/front normal and bokeh modes.
ApsPreviewDecision23821 exposes HQ RAW, TurboHDR, HDR, night, sensor-mode and quick-shot decision functions.
oppseg.json declares product 8750, QCOM and QNN 2.25.17.241017.
selfbokehParam.json declares product 8750, ODNN_QNN and APS_API_VERSION 6.0.
feature_surface_observed: BasicTone with separate 10-bit/8-bit vignette and dither parameters
Video AI NR including Dolby-specific configuration

binary_evidence: libOPAlgoCamHybridRaw.so contains source paths under stage2_postproc/stableDiffusionSR.
Observed components include Unet, VaeEncoder, VaeDecoder, Sampler and PostSRNet.
libhybridraw_tuningparams.so references the five model files.
stable_diffusion_sr.conclusion: This is a distinct high-super-resolution branch and is not evidence of a requirement for baseline 10-bit/HDR capture.

next_steps: Inventory the matching main module um8s_op13_ocvm or a stock-equivalent userspace to close the dynamic dependency graph.
Build an explicit stock logical-camera/physical-module map; preserve dodgetele2 as a valid OnePlus 13 tele route.
Compute stock-vs-addon file deltas and classify replacements by feature family.
Modularize high-cost AI-SR models only behind dependency/tuning compatibility gates.
Map P010/UltraHDR/JPEG_R/HEIC and HQ RAW/TurboHDR decisions into CameraBoost P0 workstreams.
Do not redistribute donor blobs in the public repository.

runtime_reference_closure.interpretation: The shipped orchestration/decision libraries contain runtime path references to additional algorithms/configs/models that are not packaged in this addon. These are lookup surfaces, not proof that every file is mandatory in every mode.
runtime_reference_closure.architecture_conclusion: The addon is best understood as a target-adapted APS orchestration/processing overlay plus selected donor libraries/models. It still expects a broader stock/main-module algorithm universe at runtime; therefore slimming and standalone repackaging require both ELF and runtime-path dependency closure.

conclusions: Stock project 23821 declares logical sensor names dodgemain/dodgefront/dodgeultrawide/dodgetele/dodgetele2.
Engineering-mode entries expose CameraId 0 main, 1 ultrawide, 2 dodgetele2 and 3 front as available modules.
Stock mode routing uses dodgetele2 for many tele photo/night/portrait/Hi-RES/XPAN paths.
Stock files also use utele/UltraTele terminology and VigTab_UTele.
Therefore tele2/6x/utele naming is not sufficient evidence of a second physical donor telephoto.
stock_ai_sr_baseline: Stock manifest already includes unet.bix and four VAE files.
Stock manifest already includes GAN enhancer and highmagsol 20x/40x/80x assets.
Stock manifest already includes tele 60x HybridRAW models.
stock_crosscheck.interpretation: The addon replaces or extends an existing OnePlus 13 HybridRAW/AI-SR family. It should be analyzed as a delta overlay, not as a package that creates this capability from scratch.

modularization_candidate.policy: Optional-pack candidate only. Do not fall back to stock models unless compatibility with the donor HybridRAW libraries/tuning is proven; alternatively disable the donor SR branch when the donor model pack is absent.
